outline: Perform a give-and-go play with a teammate. Start by gaining possession of the ball and passing it to the teammate. If the opponent is below the teammate, move to the side to set up a receiving position. Position effectively to create a passing angle and receive the return pass from the teammate.

nodes.termination: Coach has possession of the ball.

nodes.termination: Ball is received by the teammate.

target.info: Move to the side, setting up a receiving position to create a passing angle.

nodes.info: Move to the side, setting up a receiving position to create a passing angle and ahead of the opponent in height.
nodes.termination: Coach is positioned with a good angle for the pass and ahead of the opponent in height.

nodes.info: Receive the ball back from the teammate.
nodes.termination: Coach regains possession of the ball.
